'''2007 Minnesota State Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 30 June 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 Regional Bespin.pdf]]). The file is named Bespin Regionals; the sheets are headed MN States (30 June 2007), except Daniel Thorson's, headed "Bespin Regionals, Jun 30th".

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 30 June 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
